headline: 00 Oct 23, at the scan boundary) -- US envoy Tom Barrack to Mario Nawfal
dek: Asked 'Could there be a strike this weekend? Absolutely,' Barrack said.
sources: Tom Barrack (US ambassador to Turkey, Syria point man — no direct Iran role), interview with podcast host Mario Nawfal during Gulf visit; reported by L'Orient Today
fault_line: Regime change or not? Netanyahu orders the IDF and Mossad to topple Tehran; Trump's own envoy says the consequence 'won't be regime change' — who speaks for Washington?

sections.what_happened: Asked 'Could there be a strike this weekend? Absolutely,' Barrack said. He added Trump is 'open and available and accessible to a deal and we've been at the table for months and months and months.' On regime change, contradicting Netanyahu's directive to IDF/Mossad: 'The consequence won't be regime change... The United States — the president of the United States — has said he's not interested in regime change. The problem with regime change always is, what's the day-two scenario?'
sections.what_verified: L'Orient Today (T3) carries the direct quotes from the podcast interview. The quotes are Barrack's own on-record words (primary source). Context (no-strikes-before-midterms position) corroborated by multiple earlier scans (totw-20261023-1100-01: White House no Iran strikes before Nov 3).
sections.what_disputed: Trump himself on the same question: 'I have no idea' (L'Orient Today). White House position (multiple scans): no strikes before the Nov 3 midterms. Barrack has NO direct Iran role — his 'absolutely' is speculation, not policy. Netanyahu's directive to IDF/Mossad stands: regime overthrow is 'the only way'. L'Orient Today notes Netanyahu faces the Oct 27 Knesset election Tuesday.
sections.why_matters: Washington contradicts itself in 24 hours: a US envoy says a weekend strike is 'absolutely' possible — and in the same breath says regime change is off the table, directly undercutting Netanyahu's directive to the IDF. Watch what happens, not what they say.
sections.context: Background: NEW (published 23:00 Oct 23, at the scan boundary) -- US envoy Tom Barrack to Mario Nawfal: weekend strike on Iran 'Absolutely' possible; contradicts Netanyahu on regime change — 'the consequence won't be regime change... what's the day-two scenario?'

totw_analysis: Our read: Washington contradicts itself in 24 hours: a US envoy says a weekend strike is 'absolutely' possible — and in the same breath says regime change is off the table, directly undercutting Netanyahu's directive to the IDF. Watch what happens, not what they say. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Regime change or not?
